summary: Doctor keeps source-build checks opt-in and gives people setup advice when the local daemon is unavailable.

replay.detail: No additional projection or replay changes beyond the read-only diagnostic prerequisite.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or fleet rule changes.

compatibility.detail: The additive doctor --developer flag checks local source-build tool availability without compiling or contacting the daemon or GitHub. Human local connection failures recommend st or st setup; native drivers and seat callers keep their existing recovery text. Doctor JSON includes a failed daemon check on connection failure and retains exit code 5.

manual.detail: Use doctor --developer for local source-build checks and add --strict to fail on missing tools. Ordinary doctor does not request developer-tool installation. Uncertified platform evidence remains visibly unknown under the read-only diagnostic prerequisite.

recovery.detail: No persistent state changes; the previous CLI restores its previous flags and error text.
